step.cmd: Determine if the CS is 8 - converted to manual pay :
Determine if there is a registration number for the issue:
In FTS, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign a registration number as follows:
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) to stop payment as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
BPC: Select the BPC of the appropriate claim.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work Type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “Urgent. Stop payment as of w/c [XXXX].”
Remarks line 2: Type “Adjudication is required to determine if the client is entitled to benefits while attending non-referred training.”
Remarks line 3: Type your name and telephone number.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In NWS, reassign the WI as follows:

ul.li:
Details: Type the appropriate reason:
“Unable to contact client for fact-finding.”
“Not within Level 1 authority — The non-referred training is more than 25 hours per week.”
“The non-referred training is at a location that can prevent the client from providing care or support to the patient.”
“There is doubt as to whether the client is providing care for the patient while on non-referred training.”
When the Warning window is displayed, select Ok .
